reason: A race's own components carry nothing a label reads: its ability scores come from SelectableRaceStat or its heritage selection, and its traits are features it grants, each summarized apart.
text: A heritage, picked with the race, sets its ability scores (the classic one: +2 Dexterity and +2 Charisma, -2 Constitution). Healed by negative energy and harmed by positive energy, immune to level and ability drain, +2 on saves against mind-affecting effects and disease.
